text:
sophia: Quick design review — compact 'history compare' flyout prototype: https://figma.redwood/design/compare-proto. Main concerns: focus trap when opening compare, SR announcements for diff summary, CTA copy, and contrast on diff highlights. Thoughts?

devon: looks neat. focus trap is failing with keyboard — tab goes into timeline behind the modal. can repro. :eyes:

zane: i can repro too. prob is overlay z-index + focusable commit items. quick fix: set background to aria-hidden and autofocus first control. snippet:```
<body aria-hidden="true">...
<div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="compare-title">...
```

lucy: copy nit: 'Compare snapshot' reads ambiguous. suggest 'Compare to previous' or 'Compare with baseline'. shorter = 'Compare to previous'.

sophia: agree on 'Compare to previous'. also need an aria-live update when diffs load: screen reader should get 'Comparison loaded: 3 changes, 1 breaking change'.

aria-bot: accessibility-checker: color-contrast fail on green diff bg (#00b37e on #ffffff) — 2.9:1. target >= 4.5:1 for body text.

devon: ok — we used green full background for added lines. proposed alternatives: darker green (#007a5a) or switch to border-only highlight (2px left border) + subtle bg for hover.

zane: border-only sounds good. also suggest a keyboard shortcut: pressing `c` while a commit is focused opens compare. question: does that conflict with compose shortcuts?

lucy: not assigned today. careful with single-letter shortcuts—`c` could conflict. prefer `Shift+C` or `Cmd+Shift+C` for desktop. for accessibility we still need visible affordance.

sophia: action items: devon - add aria-hidden on background + autofocus + include aria-live summary; zane - prototype keyboard shortcut + check collisions; lucy - update copy to 'Compare to previous' and provide short alt labels; devon - propose color/border options and ping @design for final choice.

devon: :thumbsup: i'll PR today. i'll include a short usability test note in the PR checklist: 'confirm SR announces diff summary and focus lands on close button after open'.

lucy: mobile note — the flyout becomes a full-screen sheet on small screens; confirm focus trap still works and scrubber is reachable by VO.

zane: also: when opening compare from a canary variant in rollout timeline, pre-select that variant in the compare view. otherwise it's confusing which variant you're comparing.

sophia: good call — add to PR checklist.

aria-bot: deploy-bot: flag `snapshot-compare-ui` toggled on staging.
